test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Find the gain percentage, given that Siddhi sold her scooter for ₹28935 gaining (1)/(5)th of the selling price.
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹28935

Gain = (1/5) of the Selling Price

**Formula Used:**

Gain % = (Gain / Cost Price) × 100

Cost Price (CP) = SP - Gain

**Calculation:**

Gain = (1/5) × SP

⇒ Gain = (1/5) × 28935

⇒ Gain = 5787

Cost Price (CP) = SP - Gain

⇒ CP = 28935 - 5787

⇒ CP = 23148

Gain % = (Gain / CP) × 100

⇒ Gain % = (5787 / 23148) × 100

⇒ Gain % = 0.25 × 100

⇒ Gain % = 25%

**The gain percentage is 25%.**
